daily.title: Putin announces release of imprisoned US citizen during meeting with Witkoff
daily.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has said that Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old US citizen held in Russian custody since 2022, had been freed and was at Pulkovo Airport in St Petersburg.

daily.title: Man arrested for allegedly making threats at WA MP's office with nunchucks
